caveat: fully routed hierarchy: all eight analog cells (efuse_bitcell, efuse_ls, efuse_rowdrv, efuse_coldrv, efuse_comp, efuse_sense, efuse_row and efuse_otp_array) are routed (see 'routed'); the five fuse-free cells LVS-match their subckts under pinned klt 0.9.2 while the three fuse-bearing cells (efuse_bitcell, efuse_row, efuse_otp_array) carry LVS probes only -- analog item 4 LVS signoff with recognized fuses remains with #32

planes.m1: device pads, guard-ring taps and the source-ring bridge
planes.m2: supply rails, horizontal runs, stubs and rowdrv-to-row wl bridges
planes.m3: vertical stubs, lanes and local via2-to-via3 landing pads
planes.m4: top-level horizontal signal/supply buses, local coldrv jumpers and rowdrv vertical supply rails
planes.m5: top-level vertical bit-line trunks (10 um), supply trunks/feeders (10 um vss/vprog, 1.2 um vdd33) and sense drops

program_path.claim: path delivery only (spec section 3): no claim that the fuse changes state or that a pulse programs it
program_path.target: >= 10 mA through the fuse at the worst corner (spec section 2, assumption A2 and decision 0002: no PDK source)
program_path.simulated: sim/corner-verification record 20261123T205019Z-f6eeac7. All 135 schematic points pass with 20 ohm assumed route resistance. The minimum is 10.8722 mA at ss / 125 C / vdd33 2.97 V / vprog 4.5 V / 260 ohm, a 0.8722 mA margin over A2.
program_path.current_limits: GF180 design manual section 14.2, tables 14.3-14.4 (https://gf180mcu-pdk.readthedocs.io/en/latest/physical_verification/design_manual/drm_14_2.html). At 125 C the unidirectional limits are 0.67 mA/um for M1-M4, 1.21 mA/um for M5 (9000 angstrom MetalTop) and 0.18 mA per 0.26 um via. For same-direction rectangular pulses with zero idle current, average current equals pulse current times the duty cycle on that segment. A2 requires 10 mA during the pulse. A3 gives pulse width only. Applying the EM limits requires a repetition rate and current sharing.
program_path.resistance_estimate: See layout/README.md for the selected-cell routed DC model, terminal definitions, PDK coefficients and controls.

resistors.source: sm141064.ngspice .param rsh_ppolyf_u (350) and the ppolyf_u model card's r_dl/r_dw deltas and its two series terminal resistors (ppolyf_u_t, rsh 60); the netlist states r_length/r_width and the drawn body is exactly that geometry
resistors.note: ohms_lvs_drawn is the deck's LVS value (drawn L/W * rsh), which both compare sides compute from the same geometry; ohms_sim_nominal applies the model deltas and both terminal resistors (25 C, typical) and is what the netlist's lengths were solved for
